name: dubainight-reports
description: Private staging reports for Dubai Night admins, with venue coverage, URLs and recorded website page views.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only venue coverage and recorded page views.
interface.longDescription: Generate read-only reports from Dubai Night staging data for Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Find articles, events, offers and venue pages, inspect recorded page views and export a complete CSV. Requires an approved reporting account. Missing and partial metrics are clearly identified.
defaultPrompt: Find all pages mentioning Amazonico in Dubai.
Show the top articles mentioning a venue by lifetime views.
Build a venue coverage report and export it as CSV.
